name: Lethal Patience
body:
Lethal Patience (Ex)
Source Chronicle of Legends pg. 5
While wild flurries of bullets are certainly effective at felling foes, veteran gunslingers appreciate the value of lining up the perfect shot. At 15th level, the gunslinger can spend 1 grit point to line up a shot against a target as a full-round action. On her next turn, she can make an attack against the target as a standard action, and if the attack hits, the attack is treated as a critical threat. This deed replaces the slinger's luck deed and one other 15th-level deed.
